main.description: Append an OBSERVED public fault/repair bulletin to the kotoba Datom log (:cable.fault/*). Wellbecoming = as-of history: faults are appended, never overwritten (非終末論). CONSTITUTIONAL (watatsuna G4): :kind mirrors only the public bulletin's OWN classification — watatsuna NEVER asserts sabotage intent (a state matter). kotoba-native successor to telecom.recordSubmarineCableRepair + telecomInfra.flagCableFault.

kind.description: the public BULLETIN's own classification; NOT an intent adjudication by watatsuna

locationLatMicrodeg.description: WGS84 latitude × 1e6 (microdegrees); public bulletin's stated position only (G1)

locationLonMicrodeg.description: WGS84 longitude × 1e6 (microdegrees); public bulletin's stated position only (G1)

repairVessel.description: public AIS-named cable ship if disclosed; live position beyond public AIS is out of scope (G1)

bulletinUri.description: public source URI for the classification
